title: Claude Code activity
description: Sessions, then their prompts, then each prompt's model calls, tool calls and responses, including their content. Share only with the people who can read the telemetry bucket.

query.rawSQL: SELECT DISTINCT owner FROM usage WHERE dt >= date_format(now() - interval '90' day, 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') ORDER BY 1

SELECT session_id AS __value, concat(format_datetime(max(event_time), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' ', owner, ' ', substr(session_id, 1, 8)) AS __text FROM events WHERE dt BETWEEN date_format($__timeFrom(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND date_format($__timeTo(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND owner IN (${owner:sqlstring}) AND session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session_id, owner ORDER BY max(event_time) DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT trace_id AS __value, concat(format_datetime(min(event_time), 'HH:mm:ss'), ' ', coalesce(substr(max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'user_prompt' THEN attrs['prompt'] END), 1, 80), trace_id)) AS __text FROM events WHERE dt BETWEEN date_format($__timeFrom(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND date_format($__timeTo(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND owner IN (${owner:sqlstring}) AND session_id = ${session:sqlstring} AND trace_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trace_id ORDER BY min(event_time) DESC

panels.title: Sessions

targets.rawSQL: SELECT session_id AS session, owner, min(event_time) AS started, max(event_time) AS last_activity, count_if(event_name = 'user_prompt') AS prompts, count_if(event_name = 'tool_result') AS tool_calls, count_if(event_name = 'tool_decision' AND attrs['decision'] <> 'accept') AS rejected, round(sum(CASE WHEN event_name = 'api_request' THEN CAST(attrs['cost_usd'] AS double) END), 2) AS cost_usd FROM events WHERE dt BETWEEN date_format($__timeFrom(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND date_format($__timeTo(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND owner IN (${owner:sqlstring}) AND session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Click a session to show its prompts below

panels.title: Prompts

targets.rawSQL: SELECT min(event_time) AS time, trace_id, max(CASE WHEN event_name = 'user_prompt' THEN substr(attrs['prompt'], 1, 300) END) AS prompt, count_if(event_name = 'tool_result') AS tool_calls, count_if(event_name = 'api_request') AS model_calls, round(sum(CASE WHEN event_name = 'api_request' THEN CAST(attrs['cost_usd'] AS double) END), 4) AS cost_usd, round(to_milliseconds(max(event_time) - min(event_time)) / 1000.0, 1) AS seconds FROM events WHERE dt BETWEEN date_format($__timeFrom(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND date_format($__timeTo(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND owner IN (${owner:sqlstring}) AND session_id = ${session:sqlstring} AND trace_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trace_id ORDER BY 1 DESC

value.title: Show this prompt's trace and transcript

panels.description: Click a prompt to show its trace and transcript below

panels.title: Trace: model calls and tool calls

targets.rawSQL: SELECT trace_id AS traceID, span_id AS spanID, parent_span_id AS parentSpanID, CASE name WHEN 'claude_code.interaction' THEN concat('Prompt: ', coalesce(substr(attrs['user_prompt'], 1, 100), '')) WHEN 'claude_code.llm_request' THEN concat('Model call ', coalesce(attrs['model'], ''), ' in ', coalesce(attrs['input_tokens'], '0'), ' / out ', coalesce(attrs['output_tokens'], '0'), ' tokens') WHEN 'claude_code.tool' THEN concat('Tool ', coalesce(attrs['tool_name'], ''), ': ', coalesce(substr(coalesce(attrs['full_command'], attrs['file_path']), 1, 100), '')) WHEN 'claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user' THEN concat('Permission: ', coalesce(attrs['decision'], ''), ' (', coalesce(attrs['source'], ''), ')') WHEN 'claude_code.tool.execution' THEN CASE attrs['success'] WHEN 'false' THEN concat('Run failed: ', coalesce(substr(attrs['error'], 1, 100), '')) ELSE 'Run' END ELSE name END AS operationName, owner AS serviceName, start_ms AS startTime, duration_ms AS duration, CASE status_code WHEN 2 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS statusCode, status_message AS statusMessage, json_format(CAST(transform(map_entries(map_filter(attrs, (k, v) -> v IS NOT NULL AND k NOT IN ('app.version', 'claude_scan.kit_version', 'enduser.id', 'gen_ai.conversation.id', 'gen_ai.provider.name', 'session.id', 'span.type', 'terminal.type', 'user.id', 'user_prompt'))), e -> MAP(ARRAY['key', 'value'], ARRAY[e[1], e[2]])) AS json)) AS tags FROM spans WHERE dt BETWEEN date_format($__timeFrom(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND date_format($__timeTo(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND owner IN (${owner:sqlstring}) AND trace_id = ${prompt:sqlstring} ORDER BY start_ms

panels.description: The prompt's spans: each model call, and each tool call with its permission decision and run

panels.title: Transcript

targets.rawSQL: SELECT seq AS step, event_time AS time, CASE event_name WHEN 'user_prompt' THEN 'Prompt' WHEN 'api_request' THEN 'Model call' WHEN 'tool_decision' THEN 'Permission' WHEN 'tool_result' THEN 'Tool' WHEN 'assistant_response' THEN 'Response' WHEN 'api_error' THEN 'Model error' ELSE event_name END AS event, attrs['tool_name'] AS tool, coalesce(attrs['decision'], CASE attrs['success'] WHEN 'true' THEN 'ok' WHEN 'false' THEN 'failed' END) AS result, attrs['model'] AS model, CAST(attrs['input_tokens'] AS bigint) AS input_tokens, CAST(attrs['output_tokens'] AS bigint) AS output_tokens, CAST(attrs['cost_usd'] AS double) AS cost_usd, substr(coalesce(attrs['prompt'], attrs['tool_parameters'], attrs['response'], attrs['error']), 1, 1000) AS content FROM events WHERE dt BETWEEN date_format($__timeFrom(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND date_format($__timeTo(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND owner IN (${owner:sqlstring}) AND trace_id = ${prompt:sqlstring} AND event_name IN ('user_prompt', 'api_request', 'tool_decision', 'tool_result', 'assistant_response', 'api_error') ORDER BY seq

panels.description: Every event of the prompt, in order, with the first 1,000 characters of its content

targets.rawSQL: SELECT event_time AS time, owner, session_id, trace_id, tool_name, decision, source, substr(tool_parameters, 1, 1000) AS parameters FROM tool_decisions WHERE decision <> 'accept' AND dt BETWEEN date_format($__timeFrom(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND date_format($__timeTo(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND owner IN (${owner:sqlstring}) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT event_time AS time, owner, session_id, trace_id, model, status_code, substr(error, 1, 500) AS error FROM api_errors WHERE dt BETWEEN date_format($__timeFrom(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND date_format($__timeTo(), 'year=%Y/month=%m/day=%d/hour=%H') AND owner IN (${owner:sqlstring}) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 500
